human.problem: Verse 7 shows the frightened nations' craftsmen welding a made object and nailing it down so it will not topple. The previous passage (Isaiah 40:19-20) shows this object is an idol, and the passage contrasts it with the LORD. The walkthrough never says what is being built, and the joke ('I have NEVER had a coworker hype my work like that') presents the work as admirable. The baker can miss the point of verses 5-7.
human.question: In Isaiah 41:7, should Papa Dorin say the craftsmen are making an idol, citing Isaiah 40:19-20? The docs allow filling in what the text clearly implies and using outside facts with their reference. They also say to leave open what the text leaves open, and verse 7 never says 'idol'.
